title: A Chinatown bridge permit put removal costs on the owner. The City later paid for access.

beats.text: The Board said a hotel’s bridge permit required the owner to pay for removal.

visual.sub: The Board assigned removal costs to the bridge permittee

visual.label: The Board assigned removal costs to the bridge permittee

beats.text: On the first park tender, a bid discount changed the ranking.

visual.kicker: A bid preference changed the original price ranking before all bids were rejected

beats.text: A $300,000 adjustment put Swinerton ahead. The City rejected all three bids.

visual.kicker: A bid preference changed the original price ranking before all bids were rejected

beats.text: After the scope changed, Swinerton offered the lowest base bid outright.

visual.kicker: The same three firms returned after the scope changed

visual.label: The same three firms returned after the scope changed

beats.text: The hotel owner then reported receiving $350,000 from the City.

visual.label: The owner reported receiving two City payments before a final settlement

beats.text: That paid for entry and related costs under a term sheet.

visual.kicker: The owner reported receiving two City payments before a final settlement

beats.text: Another $3.5 million was conditional on a final settlement.

visual.kicker: The owner reported receiving two City payments before a final settlement

beats.text: The owner would pay $85,000 a month for 60 months.

visual.label: The owner reported receiving two City payments before a final settlement

visual.kicker: The owner reported receiving two City payments before a final settlement

beats.text: The City’s construction voucher went to Swinerton. It covered different work.

visual.kicker: The City’s construction voucher goes to a different payee

beats.text: The final settlement would show who ultimately carries the cost.
